import { SimWorld } from '/Users/wesner/Workspace/minorincident/.claude/worktrees/s86-weaponpower/src/sim/world/SimWorld.ts';
for(const name of ['molotov','flamethrower','pipe-bomb','rocket-launcher']){const w=new SimWorld();await w.init();w.loadScenario('combat-arena',1);const action='weapon.'+name;w.combat!.setLoadout([action],['weapon.fire-axe']);const ids=[-1.2,-.6,0,.6,1.2].map(z=>w.spawnDummy('infected.dummy',{x:2,z:name==='flamethrower'?z/4:z},{hp:60}));if(name==='rocket-launcher')w.explosions!.blast('explosion.rocket',{x:2,z:0},{sourceId:1,actionId:action,radius:6});else w.setInput({aim:{x:1,z:0},aimPoint:{x:2,z:0},left:{down:true,held:true,up:false}});w.update();if(name!=='flamethrower')w.clearInput();for(let t=1;t<180;t++)w.update();const hp=ids.map(id=>w.entities.get(id)!.health.current);console.log(JSON.stringify({weapon:name,kills:hp.filter(h=>h===0).length,remainingHp:hp,seconds:3,method:name==='rocket-launcher'?'native centered explosion':'single native trigger'}));w.dispose();}
